title: [YouPass Collect] - Solar Panel
prompt: The diagrams show the structure of the solar panel and its use. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagrams illustrate the basic structure of a solar panel system and demonstrate how it can be utilized to heat both air and water.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the solar heating system involves several main stages, beginning with solar energy collection through a transparent top and concluding with the output of heated air or water for practical use.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Initially, the system consists of a box equipped with a transparent top that allows sunlight to enter while trapping heat inside. The box contains an inlet and outlet mechanism that facilitates the flow of cool substances into the system and the exit of heated materials. In the air heating process, cool air enters through the inlet, where it is warmed by sun rays that penetrate the transparent cover and generate heat energy within the enclosed space. The heated air is then expelled through the outlet, providing warm air for various applications.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Meanwhile, the water heating system follows a similar principle but incorporates an additional component. Cool water enters the system through the inlet and flows through a water pipe positioned inside the box. As with the air heating process, sun rays pass through the transparent top and heat the water as it travels through the internal piping system. Finally, the warmed water exits through the outlet, ready for domestic or commercial use.
